quote: You walk through rooms filled with quiet ghosts. People look right through your fragile longing. Every smile hides a heavy unspoken grief. You pretend the silence doesn't hurt you. Yet your chest aches for deeper connection. We carry sorrows we never learned to name. Let the darkness gently hold you tonight.
